name: Agent/skill Context tabs render attached specs, missing badge, and token total; the run drawer's Project context segment shows the untrusted-delimited injected text
description: Three legs, all against read-only seeded data (no model call). Leg 1: open the seeded Security Reviewer agent (server/src/db/seed.ts securityReviewerAttachments), its Context tab, and confirm the three attached filenames (specs/security-baseline.md, specs/public-api.md, specs/deleted-doc.md) render, the 'missing in repo' badge appears for deleted-doc.md (deliberately never written to the fixture repo, per EC-7), and the footer token-total line renders. Leg 2: open the seeded 'PR Quality Rubric' skill (skillIdBySlug 'pr-quality-rubric', attached to specs/public-api.md), its Context tab, and confirm the SERIALIZES AS panel (useSkillContextPreview -> service.ts previewSkillContext) contains the '## Project context' heading and the '<untrusted source="spec:' delimiter (AC-9) — scoped to the panel's own `pre.mono` element (unique on this tab; verified against the client source) rather than the whole page, since the raw attached path 'specs/public-api.md' legitimately also appears elsewhere on the same screen (the ContextPicker's own document list) and a page-wide check would not discriminate a bare-list regression from the correct serialization. No separate stdoutExcludes 'bare list' check is added: with a single attached document there is no substring that is present in a hypothetical bare-list rendering but absent from the correct delimited one, so the positive heading+delimiter assertions (which a bare list of paths could not satisfy) are the achievable proof; see the implementer report for this reasoning. Leg 3: open PR #482 (seed's fixtureCommitSha run_traces row), the Agent runs tab, the run drawer via the timeline's 'Open run trace & logs' button, expand 'Prompt assembly' then the 'Project context — attached specs (untrusted)' segment (trace.prompt.specs — a UI label only, not part of the serialized text; reviewer-core/src/prompt.ts's assembly.specs carries no '## Project context' heading, so this leg does not assert that heading), and confirm the '<untrusted source="spec:' delimiter and the actual injected specs/security-baseline.md text are visible. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (e2e-web.yml / scripts/e2e.sh) where acme/payments-api is the first repo, PR #482 is seeded with a completed Security Reviewer run trace, and Security Reviewer / PR Quality Rubric carry the attachments above.
